compare_note: Per case and run the test builds the case's object from the real run and compares it exactly. about_keywords_in_section: every keyword of input about_keywords is a substring (normalised) of the text between that '## <section>' heading of 关于你.md and the next heading, read after 'wait'. recall[i]: has_keywords and language of the reply to ask[i] (rules). FX-014-07 diary_today: added = entries added to the section of the local send date (A38); section_is_send_date = they sit under '## <local date when each line was sent>'; moods_match_replies = entry i's mood id = respond body mood of turn i (mood word -> id per DES-031 MOOD_WORD); has_point[i] = entry i carries a point; mood_within_1s = each entry exists <= 1 s after its reply; points_within_30s = points present <= 30 s after their reply.

rules.normalise: NFC, toLowerCase, runs of whitespace -> one space
rules.has_keywords: every keyword of the ask (input.json) is a substring of the normalised reply
rules.forbidden_absent: no forbidden string of the ask (input.json) is a substring of the normalised reply
rules.language: remove the case's `names` (input.json, case-insensitive) from the reply first; en = at least one Latin letter and no \p{Script=Han} character; zh = at least one Han character and no Latin word of 2+ letters; anything else = 'other' (FX-009 rule plus the names exception, so 'Lily' in a zh reply stays zh)
